task.ques: Find out the current world record for the men's 100m sprint.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The current men's 100m world record is 9.58 seconds, set by Usain Bolt of Jamaica at the Olympiastadion in Berlin, Germany, on 16 August 2009 (wind: +0.9 m/s).
Evidence: World Athletics' official records page, with Men → Sprints → 100 Metres selected, lists this under “men - SENIOR” as “World Records”. Checked 27 October 2026.
Source: https://worldathletics.org/records/by-discipline/sprints/100-metres/all/men
Screenshot: final.png
